summary.text: This resolution recognizes domestic and global progress towards ending the HIV epidemic and calls for additional efforts, with a particular focus on reducing HIV-related vulnerabilities of women and girls.

title: Supporting the goals and ideals of National Women and Girls HIV/AIDS Awareness Day.
